description: Platform-neutral app and site descriptions. Launch details live under platforms; every client renders this file (ADR-0018).

apps.purpose: Payments, transfers, bills and mini programs.
actions: Sending money or paying a bill is a payment: always ask, show the amount and recipient.
Never read a password or verification code; hand login to the user.

apps.purpose: Open AppGallery. Search for an app by name.
actions: Install with the Install button; review permissions first.
Updates are under Me > Updates.

apps.purpose: Search, news feed and mini programs.
actions: Reading is safe; publishing or commenting is public: ask first.

apps.purpose: Video, search, comments, favourites, downloads.
actions: Watching is safe; posting, commenting and following are public actions: ask.
If the app is absent, use https://www.bilibili.com in the built-in browser.

apps.purpose: Open Browser. The address bar accepts a URL or a search.
actions: Search results open in the same tab unless opened long-press.
Tabs are managed from the tab counter.

apps.purpose: Open Calendar. Use + to create an event.
actions: Set the title, start and end time, then save.
Switch between day, week and month views.

apps.purpose: Open Camera. The shutter takes a photo.
actions: Switch between photo and video.
Open the gallery from the thumbnail.

apps.purpose: Open Clock. The Alarm tab lists alarms.
actions: Add an alarm with the + button; set the time and repeat days.
Delete an alarm with a long press.

apps.purpose: Open Contacts. Use the search field for a name.
actions: Open a contact to call, message or edit.
Create a contact with the + button.

apps.purpose: Feed, search, profile, messages, shopping.
actions: Liking, commenting, following, posting and buying are public or paid actions: ask first.
Purchases inside Douyin are payments: always ask, show the total.
Web fallback: https://www.douyin.com.

apps.purpose: Open Files. Browse categories or internal storage.
actions: Use search for a file name.
Long-press a file for copy, move, rename or delete.

apps.purpose: Open Gallery. Albums are on the Albums tab.
actions: Search by place, object or date.
Long-press a photo to share or delete.

apps.purpose: Shopping, search, cart and orders.
actions: Checkout is a payment: always ask, show the item and total.
Publishing a review is public: ask first.

apps.purpose: Short video, live, messages, shop.
actions: Liking, commenting, following, posting and buying: ask first.
Live gifts and shop purchases are payments: always ask.

apps.purpose: Open Music. Search or browse the library.
actions: Tap a track to play; the mini player controls pause and next.
Playlists are under My Music.

apps.purpose: Open Notes. Use + to create a note.
actions: Type the body, then go back to save.
Search notes with the magnifier.

apps.purpose: Open Petal Maps. Search for a place or address.
actions: Start a route with the directions button.
Choose walking, driving or transit.

apps.purpose: Browser, search, documents and downloads.
actions: Reading is safe; submitting a form or message needs approval.

apps.purpose: Flights, hotels, trains and travel search.
actions: Booking is a payment: always ask, show dates, destination and total.

apps.purpose: Open Settings to change Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Display or Battery.
actions: Wi-Fi: Settings > WLAN. Toggle the switch.
Bluetooth: Settings > Bluetooth. Toggle the switch.
Display: Settings > Display & brightness.

apps.purpose: Shopping, search, cart, orders and reviews.
actions: Checkout is a payment: always ask, show the item and total.
Publishing a review is public: ask first.

apps.purpose: Flights, hotels, trains and travel search.
actions: Booking is a payment: always ask, show dates, destination and total.

apps.purpose: Chats, contacts, search, Moments, Pay, mini programs.
actions: Sending a message is public and effectively irreversible: show recipient and text, then ask.
WeChat Pay is a payment: always ask, show amount and merchant if visible.
Never read a verification code or password; hand login to the user.

apps.purpose: Feed, search, profile, comments, direct messages.
actions: To post: tap Skip if an ad shows, then tap Home. The orange + exists only on the Home feed, top-right near 1210,200.
The + has no label. Tap it, choose 写微博 (not Album), then type and tap Send. Send greys out until there is text.
Posting, reposting, commenting and following are public: ask first.
Web fallback: https://weibo.com.

apps.purpose: Documents, spreadsheets and presentations.
actions: Editing or sharing a document changes someone else's file: ask first.

apps.purpose: Marketplace listings, search, chat with sellers, orders.
actions: Buying, bidding, making an offer and confirming receipt involve money: always ask, show item, price and seller.
Publishing a listing is public: ask first.

apps.purpose: Publishing an article or changing a published post is irreversible: ask first.
actions: If no HarmonyOS app is installed, use https://baijiahao.baidu.com in the built-in browser.

apps.purpose: Jobs, search, recruiter chat, resume.
actions: Sending a message to a recruiter is public and hard to undo: ask first.
Uploading or replacing a resume changes what employers see: ask first.
Web fallback: https://www.zhipin.com.

apps.purpose: Courses, audio, notes, purchases.
actions: Buying a course is a payment: always ask.
Reading and playback are safe.

apps.purpose: Chats, docs, calendar, meetings.
actions: Sending a message or creating a meeting invites other people: ask first.
Documents can be edited collaboratively; check before overwriting content.

apps.purpose: Feed, topics, comments, messages.
actions: Posting, commenting and following are public actions: ask first.

apps.purpose: Inbox, search, read, compose, attachments.
actions: Sending mail is irreversible: show recipients, subject and body, then ask.
Never read a password or one-time code aloud; hand login over to the user.

apps.purpose: News feed, search, comments, video.
actions: Reading is safe; commenting, posting and following: ask first.

apps.purpose: Feed, search, notes, comments, messages, shop.
actions: Liking, collecting, commenting, following and posting: ask first.
Shop checkout is a payment: always ask, show the total.
